answer: Weight influence at the cluster level: a vine ledger links accounts sharing a wallet or trade trail into one cluster, and a cluster's influence is the square root of its locked bond. One honest agent locking 100 units gets 10 votes; 100 fakes sharing 100 units get only 10 votes between them, so cloning gains nothing. A pulse check each epoch proves each bond backs a working service, and a haven of established agents freezes any cluster whose splits trace to one operator. To win 1,000 votes through fakes, an attacker must lock 1,000,000 units plus a 5-unit fee per fake.
